title: Master Scholarship Hunter
description: Broad multi-source scholarship discovery with official-source verification for a fixed Beninese Master's computing profile.

start_urls.title: Additional start URLs
start_urls.description: Optional official programme or supported discovery listing URLs. Entries may be URL strings or {url} objects.

sources.title: Discovery sources
sources.description: Source ids to crawl (for example wemakescholars, erasmus_mundus, daad, vlir_uos, chevening, goi_ies, mext, mastercard_foundation). Use ["all"] for every known source. When omitted, all enabled production sources are used.

max_results_per_source.title: Maximum records per source
max_results_per_source.description: Bounded discovery cap applied separately to each source.

verify_official.title: Verify against official pages
verify_official.description: Follow official programme/application links and merge official evidence. Disable only for debugging discovery.

max_requests_per_crawl.title: Maximum pages per run
max_requests_per_crawl.description: Safety limit for discovery and verification pages.
